title: Corporate Evening
summary: Five hours of coverage for a Cleveland accounting firm's evening with clients and colleagues.
recap: Andrew Stankus Agency spent five hours covering a private evening hosted by a Cleveland accounting firm, bringing together the firm's partners, team and clients.

Coverage ran from arrivals through the last conversations of the night: candid moments between colleagues, the hosts welcoming guests, and the details of the room, delivered as a finished gallery ready for the firm's website, social channels and internal communications.
